privacy.title: Personal Data Processing Policy
privacy.meta_desc: Optisphere personal data processing policy in accordance with Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ
privacy.operator_text: The data controller is Optisphere (sole proprietorship). Personal data is processed in accordance with Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27.07.2006 'On Personal Data'.
privacy.data_text: When you contact us via the website form or chat assistant, we collect the following personal data:
data_items: Name (first name and patronymic if provided)
Telegram handle or other messenger contact
privacy.purpose_text: Collected data is used solely for:
privacy.basis_text: Personal data is processed on the basis of the data subject's consent (Art. 6, para. 1, sub-para. 1 of Law No. 152-FZ), expressed by completing the form and clicking the submit button.
privacy.retention_text: Personal data is stored for no more than 3 (three) years from the date of consent or until consent is withdrawn, whichever is earlier.
privacy.transfer_text: Personal data is not transferred to third parties except as required by Russian law. Telegram Bot API is used for notification delivery — data is transmitted in encrypted form and is not stored on the messenger's servers.
privacy.rights_text: You have the right at any time to:
rights_items: Withdraw consent to personal data processing
Request information about data being processed
Request correction or deletion of your data
privacy.rights_contact: To exercise your rights, send a request to: hello@optisphere.ru
privacy.revoke_text: Consent may be withdrawn by sending a written request to hello@optisphere.ru. Data will be deleted within 30 (thirty) days of receiving the request.
privacy.security_text: Organisational and technical measures are in place to protect personal data: data is transmitted over encrypted HTTPS, and database access is restricted.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.meta_desc: Cookie policy for the Optisphere website
cookies.what_text: Cookies are small text files that a website saves in your browser. They help the site function correctly and improve the user experience.
cookies.technical_text: Required for the website to function. Cannot be disabled.
cookies.analytics_text: Used to understand how visitors interact with the site. Data is anonymised.
analytics_items: Page view counters (no personal data transmitted)
cookies.no_trackers_text: No advertising or marketing trackers from third parties are installed on this website (Facebook Pixel, Google Analytics, Yandex.Metrica or similar). Your data is not shared with advertising networks.
cookies.control_text: You can disable cookies in your browser settings. Disabling technical cookies may affect the chat and other site features.
